annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: One conversation backed by one supervised claude CLI process. Exported by famulus-agentd at /org/famulus/Agent1/conversations/<id>. All streaming output of a turn is delivered via signals carrying the daemon-generated turn_id returned by SendMessage.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Send a user message to the conversation. Returns a daemon-generated turn_id immediately; the response streams asynchronously via signals carrying the same turn_id.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Interrupt the in-flight turn, if any. A no-op when the conversation is idle.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Return the accumulated transcript as a JSON array of message objects in claude stream-json message shape.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Terminate the supervised claude CLI process and remove this object from the bus.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: A streamed chunk of assistant text for the given turn. Consumers concatenate chunks per turn_id in emission order.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: The CLI started a tool invocation. tool_use_id is the CLI's tool_use block id (correlates ToolCall, PermissionRequest and ToolResult); input_json is the canonical-JSON tool input; tier is the C5 permission tier resolved for this call.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: A tool invocation finished. tool_use_id matches the ToolCall it completes; result_json is the canonical-JSON tool result; is_error is true when the tool failed or was denied.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: The permission broker needs a decision for a tool call. turn_id is the in-flight turn; tool_use_id matches the ToolCall being gated. The broker reply to the CLI is blocked until RespondPermission(request_id, ...) is called on org.famulus.Agent1 or the request times out as deny. The request is also listed in the PendingPermissions property until it is settled.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: A pending PermissionRequest was settled — answered by any client via RespondPermission, or timed out. behavior is allow or deny (a timeout is deny). Every client showing a dialog for request_id MUST dismiss it.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: The turn finished. result_json validates against response-complete.schema.json; per-turn API errors are reported here with is_error true.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Process-level failure: CLI crash, unparseable stream-json, or unexpected EOF. Per-turn API errors use ResponseComplete instead.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Stable conversation id; equals the last element of this object's path and the conversation's directory name under ~/.local/share/famulus/conversations/.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: claude CLI session_id used for --resume; the empty string until the CLI has reported one. Emits PropertiesChanged.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: True from SendMessage until the matching ResponseComplete or ConversationError. Emits PropertiesChanged.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: The permission requests of this conversation that are not settled yet, oldest first, so that a client starting after a PermissionRequest was emitted can still answer it. Each entry is (request_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, tool_name, input_json, tier), with the same values as the PermissionRequest signal. A request is added before its PermissionRequest signal is emitted and removed before its PermissionResolved signal is emitted. Emits PropertiesChanged.
